summary: On paper this one is close: Detroit's best edge is to wrap up (Detroit's defense ranks 1st in broken tackles per touch, 7.6% missed). Under center, Jared Goff ranks 12th of 30 in EPA per dropback and Malik Willis ranks 18th; x-factor: Amon-Ra St. Brown gets 31% of Detroit's targets and 33% of its air yards, and Miami's pass defense ranks 25th. The model favors Miami at 53%, mostly on home field (1.7 pts) and defensive injuries (1.6 pts).

DET.detail: Detroit's defense ranks 1st in broken tackles per touch (7.6% missed). Miami ranks 19th (5.2%).
Detroit ranks 2nd in explosive play rate (9.6%). Miami's defense ranks 24th (9.1% allowed).
Detroit ranks 10th in EPA per play-action dropback (+0.14). Miami's defense ranks 31st (+0.22 allowed).

MIA.detail: Miami ranks 19th in broken tackles per touch (5.2%). Detroit's defense ranks 1st (7.6% missed).
Miami's defense ranks 24th in explosive play rate (9.1% allowed). Detroit ranks 2nd (9.6%).
Miami's defense ranks 31st in EPA per play-action dropback (+0.22 allowed). Detroit ranks 10th (+0.14).
